finish.text: Boudica was the queen of a Celtic tribe called the Iceni. She led a famous revolt against the Romans in the year AD 60.
finish.sound: Boudica was the queen of a Keltic tribe called the Iceni. She led a famous revolt against the Romans in the year AD 60.

atoms.b: The people living in Britain during Boudica’s time were known as the ((++Celts French)).
They lived in many different ((++tribes trios)) and often fought with each other.
In AD 43, the ((++Romans Greeks)) invaded and took over lots of Britain.
Many tribes, including the Iceni, followed the Romans’ rules if it meant they could keep their ((++kingdoms ovens)).

instruction.text: Select the Iceni warrior to learn more about the tribe.

feedback.finish: The Iceni lived in what is now Norfolk. We know that they were called the Iceni as they were the only tribe in Britain to write their name on their coins.

atoms.b: Boudica was married to a Celtic king called Prasutagus, who ruled the ((++Iceni Fireni)) tribe.
atoms.sound: Boudica was married to a Keltic king called Prasutagus, who ruled the Iceni tribe.

atoms.b: Before Prasutagus died, he made an agreement with the ((++Romans Russians)) that Boudica would be next to rule.
atoms.sound: Before Prasutagus died, he made an agreement with the Romans that Boudica would be next to rule.

instruction.text: Drag the Roman army onto the map of Britain.

feedback.finish: The Romans broke their promise because they wanted to expand their empire. They were very brutal when they took over the Iceni’s land.

atoms.a: Do you think Boudica was happy when the Romans took over her land?

feedback.end: Of course she wasn’t! Boudica’s land had been stolen, and she and her daughters were treated cruelly by the Romans.
